blocks.text: Team messaging platform that serves as the connective tissue for modern work

Slack has become so embedded in startup culture that "Slack me" is now a verb. Beyond messaging, Slack functions as the central nervous system for your tools - connecting notifications, workflows, and automations into a single stream that keeps everyone informed.

For automation-focused teams, Slack is often the output layer of their workflow stack. New customer signs up? Slack notification. Build fails? Slack alert. Revenue milestone hit? Slack celebration. By routing important events into channels, teams maintain awareness without checking multiple dashboards.

Slack's Workflow Builder lets non-technical team members create simple automations - approval requests, standup prompts, onboarding checklists - without writing code or involving engineering. It is lightweight automation where your team already spends their time.
Topic-based channels that keep conversations focused and searchable
Quick audio/video calls and async video messages within channels
No-code automation for approvals, forms, and routine processes
Connect with virtually every business tool your team uses
Collaborate with external partners and clients in shared channels
Powerful search across messages, files, and channels with AI summaries

Slack is the default communication layer in nearly every automation workflow we build. Its integration ecosystem means that whatever tools your team uses, Slack can tie them together into a coherent information flow.
Our team can integrate Slack into your workflow and automate the repetitive parts.
